title: FG Merger II Corp. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-10
summary: FG Merger II Corp. (FGMC), a NASDAQ-listed SPAC, filed an 8-K announcing an amendment to its merger agreement with BOXABL Inc., extending the agreement end date from March 31, 2026 to July 31, 2026, and modifying lock-up provisions for sponsor securities.
key_points: FGMC extended the merger agreement end date from March 31, 2026 to July 31, 2026
Lock-up provisions on sponsor securities will automatically expire if FGMC common stock trades at or above $20.00
The filing clarifies that 8,295,800 rights will entitle holders to 829,580 shares of common stock upon business combination
Either party can terminate if no response is received within five business days after written request
FGMC has filed a registration statement on Form S-4 including proxy statements for shareholder vote
